name: Build Apps
on:

    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

          node-version: 20

        with:

          path: dist/

    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:

          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:

          path: dist/
